commentary_title: Handysize rates ease as fleet utilisation weakens
commentary_summary: Handysize utilisation declined last week, with rates easing in tandem amid a lower tonne-mile index, reflecting softer regional demand and shorter voyage distances. | Tonnage underway in the Atlantic dropped sharply as transatlantic grain movements slowed, while congestion at key load ports eased, improving vessel turnaround and limiting rate support. | Congestion at most Asian discharge ports also declined, adding to available tonnage and indicating mild market softness, as easing port delays and reduced long-haul activity kept overall sentiment cautious.
